This site presents the workflow behind the regional Secchi disc depth (SDD) model, which is built from in situ SDD matched to Landsat Collection 2 surface reflectance. Both come from the AquaMatch data products on the Environmental Data Initiative (EDI) repository (see [Data sources](#data-sources)). Each page is one step of the workflow, shown with its code and outputs. Every page opens with a header giving its purpose, inputs, outputs, and the previous and next steps.

Two models are published, each with its own model card covering intended use, training data, performance, applicability checks, and limitations. The [production model](model_card.qmd) uses Landsat reflectance together with catchment characteristics and antecedent weather. The [band-only model](model_card_band_only.qmd) uses Landsat-derived features alone and needs no other data at inference. The two were built from the same data with the same procedure, and each card compares them.

Data preparation and application run in R. Modeling runs in Python notebooks that share the modules in `regional_clarity/python/`. Step 07 sources the R functions in `regional_clarity/R/`. Arrows are labeled with the main file each step hands to the next.

```{mermaid}
%%| file: pipeline_diagram.mmd
```

| Step | Page | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | [Download AquaMatch data](regional_clarity/00_download_AquaMatch_data.Rmd) | Download AquaMatch SDD and siteSR; apply Landsat 7-referenced handoffs. |
| 01 | [Filter AquaMatch data](regional_clarity/01_filter_AquaMatch_Data.Rmd) | Scope to the 6-state HUC4 region; SDD QC and RANSAC; siteSR scene QA and band RANSAC. |
| 02a | [Make matchups](regional_clarity/02a_make_matches.Rmd) | 5-day matchups, rain-event filter, closest image per sample. |
| 02b | [Pull site characteristics](regional_clarity/02b_pull_site_characteristics.Rmd) | Elevation and LakeCat catchment features per site. |
| 02c | [Pull weather summaries](regional_clarity/02c_pull_weather_summaries.Rmd) | gridMET antecedent-weather features (1/3/7/30-day windows). |
| 03 | [Split data](regional_clarity/03_split_data.ipynb) | Join features; fixed HUC8 holdout and CV folds. |
| 04 | [Make models](regional_clarity/04_make_models.ipynb) | Per-seed feature selection, tuning, and 4-fold XGBoost (10 seeds × 4 folds). |
| 05 | [Evaluate ensemble](regional_clarity/05_evaluate_ensemble.ipynb) | Ensemble holdout performance and SHAP. |
| 06 | [Test-set sensitivity](regional_clarity/06_test_set_sensitivity.ipynb) | Holdout RMSE across 16 holdout draws. |
| 07 | [Regional application](regional_clarity/07_regional_application.Rmd) | Apply the ensemble at in situ SDD locations, with training-domain and AOA checks. |

### Band-only baseline

Steps 04b–07b repeat steps 04–07 with the candidate features restricted to the Landsat scene itself: the harmonized bands, spectral indices, and the LaSRC flag. Everything else is identical, including the data, holdout, CV folds, tuning, and selection, so the comparison sections at the end of each page measure what the site characteristics and antecedent weather add to the production model.

| Step | Page | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 04b | [Make models (band-only)](regional_clarity/04b_make_models_band_only.ipynb) | Band-only ensemble with the same per-seed pipeline as 04. |
| 05b | [Evaluate ensemble (band-only)](regional_clarity/05b_evaluate_ensemble_band_only.ipynb) | Holdout performance and SHAP, compared with production. |
| 06b | [Test-set sensitivity (band-only)](regional_clarity/06b_test_set_sensitivity_band_only.ipynb) | The 16-draw holdout sweep, paired draw by draw with production's. |
| 07b | [Regional application (band-only)](regional_clarity/07b_regional_application_band_only.Rmd) | The regional application and applicability checks, compared with production. |

Source code: [rossyndicate/regional-clarity-RS-model](https://github.com/rossyndicate/regional-clarity-RS-model).

## Applying the model to your own data

Each model folder holds only the fitted ensemble and the files the applicability checks need. The production model is tracked in the repository under `regional_clarity/xg_models/v3_production/` and published on the Hugging Face Hub as [`bgsteele/intermountain-west-regional-clarity-sdd-landsat`](https://huggingface.co/bgsteele/intermountain-west-regional-clarity-sdd-landsat). The band-only model is under `regional_clarity/xg_models/v3_band_only/` and published as [`bgsteele/intermountain-west-regional-clarity-sdd-landsat-band-only`](https://huggingface.co/bgsteele/intermountain-west-regional-clarity-sdd-landsat-band-only). The code for applying either model lives in the source repository:

| File | Language | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`regional_clarity/R/siteSR_qa.R`](https://github.com/rossyndicate/regional-clarity-RS-model/blob/main/regional_clarity/R/siteSR_qa.R) | R | Apply the training data's observation QA to siteSR sites and observations: site geometry, pixel, temperature, and scene QA, and the per-site band-outlier filter. [Step 01](regional_clarity/01_filter_AquaMatch_Data.Rmd) uses the same functions. |
| [`regional_clarity/R/prepare_model_inputs.R`](https://github.com/rossyndicate/regional-clarity-RS-model/blob/main/regional_clarity/R/prepare_model_inputs.R) | R | Build model inputs from AquaMatch siteSR sites and QA'd observations: elevation, LakeCat catchment metrics, gridMET antecedent weather, spectral indices, and site-feature coarsening. `site_and_weather = FALSE` builds the band-only model's inputs without the web fetches. Steps [07](regional_clarity/07_regional_application.Rmd) and [07b](regional_clarity/07b_regional_application_band_only.Rmd) use the same functions. |
| [`regional_clarity/python/apply_model.py`](https://github.com/rossyndicate/regional-clarity-RS-model/blob/main/regional_clarity/python/apply_model.py) | Python | Load either 40-booster ensemble, predict SDD, and flag observations outside the training domain with the applicability checks, using that model folder's `applicability/` files. |

[Applying the model](applying_the_model.qmd) walks through accessing either model and using these helpers step by step.

## How to cite

If you use this model or code, please cite this repository by its Zenodo DOI, and cite the data products listed under [Data sources](#data-sources).

> Steele, B.G. (YYYY). *Intermountain West Regional Clarity Remote Sensing Model* (vX.Y.Z) [Software]. Zenodo. <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX>

Zenodo assigns a DOI to each GitHub release, plus a concept DOI that always resolves to the latest release. The citation above uses the concept DOI. To cite the exact release you used, take that release's version DOI from Zenodo instead.

## Data sources

All in situ and remote sensing inputs come from three AquaMatch data packages on EDI. [Step 00](regional_clarity/00_download_AquaMatch_data.Rmd) downloads them with the [`AquaMatchr`](https://github.com/AquaSat/AquaMatchr) R package (Brousil & Ross 2026), which requires an EDI account and API key. The production model was built from revision 1 of each package.

| EDI package | Product | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| [`edi.1856.1`](https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/542a305e8484ae5abc33881bd7761308) | AquaMatch Secchi disc depth | Target variable (in situ SDD) |
| [`edi.2254.1`](https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/f85622d6d32ef7fe6cff8d63c3b947c9) | siteSR | Landsat surface reflectance and temperature at sampling sites, scene-level metadata, and the site list |
| [`edi.2114.1`](https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/941f3cb046f5e7fbe04d5811989ed810) | lakeSR | Cross-sensor handoff coefficients used to harmonize all Landsat missions to Landsat 7 |

Recommended citations, as provided by EDI:

- De La Torre, J., B.G. Steele, M.R. Brousil, M.F. Meyer, K. Willi, and M.R. Ross. 2025. AquaMatch Secchi Disk Depth Data from Water Quality Portal: ~1970-2024 ver 1. Environmental Data Initiative. <https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/542a305e8484ae5abc33881bd7761308>
- Steele, B.G., M.R. Brousil, K.R. Willi, M.F. Meyer, and M.R. Ross. 2026. SiteSR: AquaMatch Landsat Collection 2 surface reflectance and surface temperature datasets for remote-sensing visible Water Quality Portal and National Water Information System sites in the United States and Territories, 1983-2024 ver 1. Environmental Data Initiative. <https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/f85622d6d32ef7fe6cff8d63c3b947c9>
- Steele, B.G., M.R. Brousil, K.R. Willi, M.F. Meyer, and M.R. Ross. 2026. lakeSR: AquaMatch Landsat Collection 2 surface reflectance and surface temperature datasets for centrally-located points of water bodies greater than 1 hectare in the United States and territories, 1983-2024 ver 1. Environmental Data Initiative. <https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/941f3cb046f5e7fbe04d5811989ed810>
